summary: All six acceptance criteria pass. FEAT-001: internal router created, mounted at /api/internal, io param correct, intelligence.ts/safety.ts untouched. FEAT-002: socket.io-client@4.7.5 in both mobile package.json files; TrackingSocket singletons guard null socket; passenger-app polling kept as fallback. FEAT-003: web trackingSocket uses import.meta.env.VITE_TRACKING_URL; LiveTracking unchanged; polling gated on !socketConnected. Token keys correct (@skyrex:token / localStorage 'token'). Handshake auth: { token } matches io.use() middleware. Three non-blocking findings documented: duplicate Redis client in internal router (pass existing instance instead of creating a second one), trip:leave emitted but no server handler (socket stays in room until disconnect), passenger TrackingSocket missing isConnected export (asymmetry with driver-app and web). None block correctness of the shipped behaviour.
changes_requested: Duplicate Redis client: internal.ts creates its own lazy createClient inside createInternalRouter while index.ts already holds a connected redisClient targeting the same URL. Pass redisClient as a second argument to createInternalRouter to avoid a second connection.

trip:leave has no server handler: passenger-app and web singletons emit trip:leave on cleanup, but tracking-service/src/index.ts has no socket.on('trip:leave') handler. Add one that calls socket.leave('trip:${tripId}') to prevent stale room membership.

Passenger TrackingSocket missing isConnected export: FEAT-002 acceptance criteria list it; driver-app and web-platform both export it. Add export function isConnected(): boolean { return socket?.connected ?? false; }.
